title: Model, scale 1:12 of Bersham boring mill 1775 (object 1927-985)
version: Dated not specified in preserved source metadata. Museum catalogue, reopened live 6 November 2026
lineage: Later reconstruction based on Gilpin's plan and period practice. Copied cache was acquired 5 November 2026 and re-read 6 November; the live source was also reopened. Its plan, assumed elevations and unknown loading details are distinguished.
